tier.description: List only the operations in this tool tier.
tier.title: Tier

operations.summary: List the operations this engine offers and whether each can be called now.

kinds.description: Only these kinds; every kind the person shares when left out. A since read keeps the kinds of the read it continues.
kinds.title: Kinds

since.description: The next_since of the previous page: the read continues after it, in commit order, with the same kinds. Without it the read starts at start_time, or at the oldest change kept.
since.title: Since

start_time.description: Without since: start with the changes recorded at or after this time, with its UTC offset. Pursuits whose next action fell due from this time on are included. Later reads with the since this read gives keep the bound.
start_time.title: Start Time

tier.description: The caller's tool tier, which bounds the page.
tier.title: Tier

NextAction.description:
A typed suggestion of an operation to call next. Never a shell string,
and never a permission the caller did not already have.
NextAction.title: NextAction

StatedBand.description: One side of a stated-pay change: the employer's base band as stated.
StatedBand.title: StatedBand

operations.summary: List what changed after a position, in commit order: new, closed, reopened and reposted postings, stated-pay changes, pursuit actions falling due and source health. Pass next_since back as since.

operation.description: A dotted operation id from capabilities.
operation.title: Operation

operations.summary: Describe one operation: its input and output schemas, effects and data classes.

description_from.description: Detail view only: read the description from this character on, as an excerpt's continue_with gives it. The pursuit's notes are then left to pursuits.get.
description_from.title: Description From

opportunity_id.description: The opportunity's id, as search returns it.
opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id

tier.description: The caller's tool tier, which bounds a detail view.
tier.title: Tier

view.description: summary, detail (adds the text) or evidence.
view.title: View

EmployerStatedPay.description: The pay band the posting itself states; null bounds when it states none.
EmployerStatedPay.title: EmployerStatedPay

EstimateSource.description:
One pay source's estimate for this posting and the answers behind it.
RoleBand's own data and a plugin's are separate sources, never mixed.
EstimateSource.title: EstimateSource

EstimatedBase.description: An estimate of base pay alone, where the data prices the posting by its base.
EstimatedBase.title: EstimatedBase

EstimatedTotalComp.description: RoleBand's estimate of total pay, from the posting's market data.
EstimatedTotalComp.title: EstimatedTotalComp

Excerpt.description:
Present when the detail is not whole: it did not fit the tier's budget,
or it was asked for from a point in the description. On a first read the
description is cut first, and the pursuit's notes only when they alone do
not fit; a read from a point leaves the notes out. `continue_with` names
the calls that read the rest, so nothing cut is out of reach.
Excerpt.title: Excerpt

NextAction.description:
A typed suggestion of an operation to call next. Never a shell string,
and never a permission the caller did not already have.
NextAction.title: NextAction

PursuitState.description: One pursuit's fields as every surface shows them.
PursuitState.title: PursuitState

output_schema.description: One posting in the view the caller asked for; `view` names which.
output_schema.title: OpportunityView

operations.summary: Read one opportunity in a declared view: summary, detail with its text, or evidence.

opportunity_id.description: The opportunity's id, as search returns it.
opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id

HistoryEvent.description: One dated fact. Every key is sent; those a kind does not use are null.
HistoryEvent.title: HistoryEvent

operations.summary: How long a posting has been listed and why: every dated event and the role's other postings.

base_pay_max.description: Highest yearly base in US dollars.
base_pay_max.title: Base Pay Max

base_pay_min.description: Lowest yearly base in US dollars, as the Board's pay filter.
base_pay_min.title: Base Pay Min

company.description: Companies, by slug or name; repeat for more.
company.title: Company

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, read with the same filters and sort.
cursor.title: Cursor

discloses_pay.description: Only postings that state a pay band.
discloses_pay.title: Discloses Pay

family.description: Role families, by slug or name.
family.title: Family

level_band.description: Level bands, such as senior or staff.
level_band.title: Level Band

listed_within_days.description: Only postings listed within this many days, by the age each row shows.
listed_within_days.title: Listed Within Days

location.description: Places, by slug or a name people use, such as London or USA.
location.title: Location

minimum_estimated_pay.description: Lowest estimated pay: the estimated total, else the estimated base.
minimum_estimated_pay.title: Minimum Estimated Pay

query.description: Words to search for, as in the Board's search box.
query.title: Query

sort.description: Default: best_match with a query, else newest.
sort.title: Sort

tier.description: The caller's tool tier, which bounds the page.
tier.title: Tier

track.description: Tracks, such as ic or management.
track.title: Track

rows.description: One array per opportunity, its values in the order `columns` names.
rows.title: Rows

operations.summary: Search the Board's open roles with its filters and sorts; one page of summary rows.

opportunity_id.description: The opportunity the pursuit is about.
opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id

operations.summary: Read one pursuit, notes included, by the opportunity it is about.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, read with the same stage. It resumes after that page's last pursuit in the current order, with no snapshot: a pursuit re-prioritised during paging can be skipped or read twice, so read from the first page for a whole list.
cursor.title: Cursor

operations.summary: List the pursuits with their stage, priority, notes and next action, by priority.

if_revision.description: The revision you read (pursuits.get or pursuits.list); 0 when the role has no pursuit yet. A pursuit that moved since is not changed.
if_revision.title: If Revision

next_action.description: The next step. null clears it; leave the field out to keep it.
next_action.title: Next Action

next_action_due.description: When the next step falls due, with its UTC offset. null clears it; leave the field out to keep it.
next_action_due.title: Next Action Due

notes.description: Replaces the notes. null clears them; leave the field out to keep them.
notes.title: Notes

opportunity_id.description: The opportunity the pursuit is about.
opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id

stage.description: The new stage. Cannot be null.
stage.title: Stage

operations.summary: Change a pursuit's stage, priority, notes or next action against the revision read. A field sent as null is cleared; a field left out is kept.

if_revision.description: The revision you read (pursuits.get or pursuits.list); 0 when the role has no pursuit yet. Given, a pursuit that moved since is not changed (revision_conflict).
if_revision.title: If Revision

priority.description: 1 to 5. A new pursuit starts at 3; an existing one keeps its own unless this is given.
priority.title: Priority

operations.summary: Save an opportunity. A new pursuit starts at saved with priority 3; an existing one keeps its stage and notes, and its priority unless one is given.

input_schema.description: The input of an operation that takes none.
input_schema.title: NoInput

output_schema.description:
The pursuit counts are absent when the person does not share their
pursuits with assistants.
output_schema.title: RadarSummary

operations.summary: Count the open and saved roles, the pursuits by stage and the follow-ups overdue.

key.description: The idempotency key the write was sent under: its meta.idempotency_key.
key.title: Key

operation.description: The write's operation id, such as pursuits.patch.
operation.title: Operation

operations.summary: Read back what a write sent under an idempotency key did. A miss is not proof it failed: send the same write again with the same key, which never writes twice.

input_schema.description: The input of an operation that takes none.
input_schema.title: NoInput

operations.summary: The listing recipe v1 JSON Schema, its transports and transforms, and the rules a recipe follows.

document.description: The listing recipe v1 document; its `id` names the recipe. It must compile.
document.title: Document

operations.summary: Save a listing recipe as a new draft revision. It never activates the recipe or binds a company.

document.description: The listing recipe v1 document to compile and preview.
document.title: Document

operations.summary: Compile a listing recipe and preview it live: two pages and five postings at most, nothing saved.

selector.description: A CSS selector: list the sanitized HTML of up to 20 matching elements instead of the text.
selector.title: Selector

url.description: A public careers page, http or https.
url.title: Url

operations.summary: Fetch one public careers page and return its sanitized text, or the elements a CSS selector matches.

input_schema.description: The input of an operation that takes none.
input_schema.title: NoInput

operations.summary: Name the workspace and the engine answering, and how the connection is trusted.

contains.description: Only values whose value or a name contains this, ignoring case and separators.
contains.title: Contains

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, read with the same kind and contains.
cursor.title: Cursor

kind.description: The filter whose accepted values to list.
kind.title: Kind

operations.summary: List the values a search filter accepts, with their names and open roles.
